notes.text: English: This handwritten leaf continues a discussion of local inertia groups and their proposed independence from the model X. It defines the stratum D_J^* by I(x)=J, writes the closed intersection as Delta_J, and asserts regularity and codimension d=card J, allowing the empty set. Hypotheses on the divisors are not restated here and their geometric sufficiency was not checked.

The oblique note now reads D_J as a subscheme followed by an inclusion sign before the closed intersection, and then defines its underlined support by I(x)=J. Conditional on I(x) being the incidence-index set, the full intersection has support I(x) containing J, whereas equality excludes extra divisors. The recovered inclusion sign permits a subscheme contained in that intersection with the exact-incidence stratum as support; the earlier possible mismatch is therefore not forced by the text. No regularity or model-independence theorem is proved here.

There is one written (36), upright with the main display. The independent audit corrects the first reading’s mistaken attachment of this number to the oblique margin. It is retained once as the display tag. The thin bottom-left 131 remains a foliation entry; its hand is not attributed to the author.

English: The source has no opening parenthesis before ou in the fourth line, although a closing parenthesis remains after de tels sous-groupes. It is not supplied. The large curve before et me convaincre is the leader from pour x variable. Four separate dots follow I_V in the first line.

English: No diagram or drawing is present. The large overbrace in the main equality is mathematical notation and is transcribed with the formula. Line_count counts 20 main text/display rows plus five oblique marginal rows; separate interlinear additions and the folio are inventoried separately.

Conditional set-theoretic check: with I finite and each D_i closed, the exact-incidence set I(x)=J is the closed intersection of the D_j, j in J, minus the finite union of the other D_i. It is therefore open in that closed intersection and locally closed in X. This supports the compatibility of the newly recovered marginal inclusion sign with the stated support, without proving the page’s regularity claim.

The independent audit leaves the last index in the second display uncertain: the preferred transcription has a bare final D, with D_j retained only as an alternative because the terminal curve is crowded against the parenthesis. It also restores the raised contraction after codim and the uncertainty on on; none of these readings is supplied from the expected formula or grammar.
